t: This is a tomb in Kensington and Chelsea, the burial place of Howe Browne, the second Marquess of Sligo. He lived from 1788 to 1845 and was an Anglo-Irish peer and colonial administrator. He was styled Viscount Westport until 1800, and then Earl of Altamont until 1809. His most notable post was governor of Jamaica, which he held from 1834 to 1836.
